topic: a letter to your future self
lines: #I thought about the version of me who's *healthier.*
Who isn't scared of opening the bank *app.*
You're being built right now, in choices nobody *sees.*
Every early morning. Every *no.* Every page.
But I promise I'll keep *coming* back.
I know you're going to be *proud.*
#When you get there, don't forget where you *came* from.
Don't forget the nights that felt *impossible.*
And be kind to the next version of you, too.
end: Write your own letter tonight. Save this.

post.title: Dear Future Me, I'm Doing This for You
post.caption: You're being built right now, in choices nobody sees. ✉️
